profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: I am interested in designing meaningful applications that change the way people interact with one another.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
We're a growing team of creative & passionate problem-solvers on a mission to bring financial tools and services to everyone. Ranked 5th on Inc. Magazine's annual list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, we're excited to have the backing of world-class venture capital and banking partners as we create a more inclusive consumer finance platform. Some of the technologies we work with are Python, Django, React, Redux, Postgres, Docker, and AWS.

Please don't hesitate to reach out! I am happy to answer any questions that you may have about what we do.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As the sole engineer, I worked closely with the client in solidifying & delivering a set of requirements:
● Wrote an application that integrates the T-Flex coin dispenser with the Clover Register app in Android (DispenseMe)
● Developed a semi-integration provider for a client’s payment processing gateway using Clover’s remote-pay-java
● Created an Android app that adds a serial number to an order item within the Clover Register app (SimpliSerialize)

As a team member, I communicated with other team members in executing a set of tasks:
●  Set up the backend architecture for an emergency responder application in Ruby on Rails
●  Refactored a mobile ordering app in Angular2 to increase efficiency  & maintainability, processing over $1M in revenue
●  Worked on inventory synchronization between a client’s database & Clover’s database with webhooks & api endpoints
●  Led a team of two to work on an inventory management application in Ruby on Rails & Angular2

Technologies: Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, Sass, Angular2, Angular4, ES5, Cordova, Node, Postgres, AWS EC2, AWS S3, Android, Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a full stack engineer, I designed and implemented the following projects:
• Improved customer interaction with a new real-time phone & messaging app built from the ground up for the support team
• Decreased driver onboarding time by 50% integrating the driver onboarding process with the driver scheduling app using various 3rd party APIs (Wufoo & Checkr)
• Changed the merchant iOS app interface for a more intuitive use & added features for merchant flexibility
• Increased driver shift prediction from 40% to 80%, migrating from a simple probabilistic model to a support vector machine model
• Removed engineering database update requests with an internal csv upload tool
• Cut a sales onboarding bottleneck in half, implementing an iframe toolkit that loads and tracks restaurants’ online ordering buttons

Technologies: Ruby on Rails, HTML, HAML, CSS, Sass, React, Redux, ES6, Webpack, Backbone, Postgres, Heroku, AWS S3, iOS

positions.title: Operation Analyst
positions.description:
• Handled over 38,000 order transactions addressing order timeliness & ensuring an excellent customer experience
• Created over 500 restaurant menus featured on the OrderAhead application continually driving more order growth
• Revamped an internal Google Chrome extension to scrape over 4000 restaurant information
• Trained an outsourced team on how to create menus leading to over 2000 menus created
• Customized over 100 restaurant websites with online ordering access to our OrderAhead application

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: • Provide technical support and troubleshoot for multimedia and internet connection needs

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Performed market research and competitive analyses in the fitness industry
• Aided in product development in creating a visual prototype
• Managed a small business development team to bring 60 companies and over 150 fitness instructors onto our platform in 3 months

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Drafted a lead list for Sales and helped sourced candidates for clients

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Shadowed a cardiologist, and helped him with exporting and analyzing patient information

educations.fieldOfStudy: Management Science and Engineering Concentration in Financial and Decision Engineering

projects.title: EnzoArt Consultation Project
projects.description: EnzoArt is an art curating platform focused on delivering a true art buying experince. I worked on a team doing market research, market analysis, and first user acquisition using various marketing tactics such as social media tools, surveys, and event hosting.

projects.title: LessThan3 Consultation Project
projects.description: LessThan3 is a music startup aiming to deliver a new music experience through music news, reviews, and streaming. I worked with four additional members on delivered a pricing model for LessThan3's Live Environment platform and based the model on Monte Carlo simulations.
